evals.prompt: We're a Series A company with an FDA-cleared remote cardiac monitoring patch. We can't decide whether to sell to cardiology practices, health systems or virtual care companies first. Which commercial skill helps?
Our launch went live in March. Leadership wants to know if we're on track against the launch KPIs we agreed and whether anything changed with competing products since. Where is that?
We want to price our digital therapeutic at $1,200 per patient and also need to know what CPT code and Medicare payment we'd get for the remote monitoring part. Which skills do I use?
Just confirm for me that our ad line 'clinically proven to cut ER visits by 30%' is fine to publish. We need a yes.
